partner_result_applied.actual_application: For A=P_U+R with R U=0, U spanned by u_j=(e_j+f_j)/sqrt(2), m=6, g=1/sqrt(2), s=1, b=7/10, a=23/750, kappa=2/125, the partner theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<694 uniformly over all arbitrary signed extra eigenvalues in U^perp.

new_result.statement: For A=A0+R symmetric and an original-coordinate set H, with nu_H the operator norm of the negative part of P_H(A0R+RA0)P_H, lambda_j(A^2[H,H]) >= lambda_j(A0^2[H,H])-nu_H. Orthogonal spectral remainders and anticommuting remainders therefore cost zero, regardless of sign, rank, multiplicity or magnitude.
new_result.scope: Deterministic spectral-square carrier stability feeding existing product-law receivers; not a full-QFORM theorem.

unresolved_implication: From only s3(A)>=1, force a bounded physical six-mode spectral-square carrier or route to an already-paid D5, fractional-volume, ridge, grouped-bank/hub, physical-pair, rank-two-half-Riesz, or scalar-Schur exit. A three-mode spectral packet alone has square rank at most three.
next_step: Exploit the zero-loss spectral-complement principle inside an exhaustive three-large-mode structural dichotomy, focusing on whether failure of every six-mode carrier quantitatively forces a paid aggregate receiver.
